newsitem.title: ITALY: Brembo 1996 profits fall, dividend held.
newsitem.headline: Brembo 1996 profits fall, dividend held.

text.p: Italian automotive brake manufacturing group Brembo on Friday announced its consolidated net profits for 1996 fell to 19.1 billion lire from 30.1 billion lire, while it held its dividend payout at 150 lire a share.
The company said in a statement its consolidated sales in 1996 rose to 357.4 billion lire from 331.2 billion lire in 1995.

The group added that it would propose a free capital issue of one share for every four shares held at an extraordinary shareholders meeting in July. Brembo plans to increase its share capital to 44.5 billion lire from 35.6 billion lire in the move.
Brembo's shares were suspended on the Milan bourse at the limit down 10 percent level after announcing its results. The shares close on Thursday at 24,050 lire.
